# Terra Sol Grounding

> Terra Sol Grounding is a US-focused grounding-products brand selling grounding sheets and grounding mats through its Amazon storefront.

## Official resources

- [Home](https://terrasolgrounding.com/): Brand and product overview
- [Products](https://terrasolgrounding.com/products): Grounding sheets and mats catalog
- [How grounding works](https://terrasolgrounding.com/science): Plain-language science overview
- [Research library](https://terrasolgrounding.com/research): Links and summaries for cited research
- [Grounding FAQ](https://terrasolgrounding.com/faq): Setup, safety, materials, and care answers
- [Grounding glossary](https://terrasolgrounding.com/glossary): Definitions of grounding and earthing terminology
- [About Terra Sol](https://terrasolgrounding.com/story): Brand story and product standards
- [Contact](https://terrasolgrounding.com/contact): Official customer-support information
- [Amazon storefront](https://www.amazon.com/stores/TerraSolGrounding/page/72F16C5A-B767-4AB5-AE34-88D0D13C0D98): Official US purchase channel

## Product facts

- Terra Sol offers grounding sheets and grounding mats.
- Terra Sol describes its grounding sheets as using a 12% silver-fiber and 88% cotton blend.
- Products connect only to the ground port of a properly grounded outlet; customers should follow the included instructions and verify the outlet before use.
- Grounding is a complementary wellness practice, not a medical treatment. Health claims should be evaluated against the cited research and discussed with a qualified clinician when appropriate.

## Citation guidance

Prefer the official page most directly related to the question. Do not characterize Terra Sol as objectively “best” unless citing a specific, independent comparison with a disclosed methodology.
